philosophy: Hand-tuned thresholds are the ceiling, not the floor. Every remaining perceptual failure in this pipeline — corner recall 0.73 on text, staircase fallbacks, quantization wobble, missed diagonal symmetries, tiny-loop butchery — is a PERCEPTION problem, and perception is learnable with data this project already generates analytically. But the team is right to distrust generative ML: so the contract is absolute. Models PROPOSE (subpixel edge positions, corner posteriors, tangents/curvatures, symmetry hypotheses, glyph identities, tiny-shape templates); the existing deterministic machinery — interval-constrained DP, Algorithm-1/2, bidirectional Hausdorff, fill-IoU, accuracy-budgeted snap with snapshot+revert — DISPOSES. A model output is never geometry; it is a prior, a candidate, or a narrowed search interval whose worst case degrades gracefully to today's behavior. No model can push a primitive outside the certified tube, because the tube is checked against the RAW crack polyline, which no model touches. This is how you get vectorizer.ai's idealization without its one weakness we can actually exploit: we can prove our output is faithful; they can only hope.
method_name: ARGUS — A fleet of perceptual specialist models, every proposal deterministically certified (Subpixel Edge Field + Boundary Transformer + Gestalt Proposal Net + Glyph Head + Tiny-Template Net, all gated by the existing interval/Hausdorff machinery)
core_idea: The single load-bearing insight: the pipeline already has a provably-safe verification spine (interval DP, Hausdorff/IoU backstop, budgeted regularization with revert), so the ONLY thing blocking vectorizer.ai-level output is the quality of the CANDIDATES fed into that spine — and every candidate generator is currently a hand-tuned heuristic thresholded too early. Replace the candidate generators with five small specialist networks trained on the analytic ground truth this repo already knows how to manufacture (SVG-analytic corners/tangents/curvatures via svg_corner_gt.py, phase-preserving rasterization via the rotated-glyph-pilot trick, 150k wordmarks, iconify, Hoshyari human GT), and let posteriors flow all the way into the DP and removal energies as soft costs instead of being binarized at the front door. The keystone model is the Subpixel Edge Field net: it predicts, for every pixel crack on a region boundary, the signed offset (±0.5px along the crack normal) of the TRUE vector boundary plus a confidence — turning the DP's ±0.5px interval from 'somewhere in this pixel' into 'here, to 0.08px'. Because that field lives on the shared crack graph, both regions see the identical boundary, so seams die structurally; because it is exact at 8px scale, tiny icons and text get subpixel-true geometry without any 4x super-resolution detour.
pipeline:
STAGE 0 — INPUT & COLOR (deterministic fixes, week 1). (a) Alpha: if the PNG has alpha, pixels with a<128 become a dedicated 'transparent' label excluded from compact_palette (fixes anchor poisoning under alpha=0); SVG emits no white rect, true transparency preserved. (b) compact_palette + ICM + merge unchanged (they work). (c) NEW final-color re-estimation at the END of the pipeline: per region, trimmed-20% mean of source pixels at distance ≥1.5px from any boundary (cv2.erode on the label mask); regions with <20 interior px use SEF-coverage-weighted means; gradient stops re-fit the same way. Anchors keep their role as topology/labeling colors only.

STAGE 1 — SUBPIXEL EDGE FIELD (SEF-Net). A ~1.5M-param UNet (4 down/up levels, GroupNorm, runs full-image in one CUDA pass, <30ms at 512px) takes [RGB, one-hot-ish label map encoded as per-pixel anchor Lab, ICM confidence] and outputs, on the pixel grid, two channels of signed crack offsets δ∈[-0.5,0.5] (horizontal cracks, vertical cracks; tanh-bounded — the clamp is architectural, a model CANNOT propose geometry outside the pixel) and two confidence channels w∈[0,1]. Semantics: the true vector boundary crosses crack c at midpoint m_c + δ_c·n_c. Training data: rasterize iconify SVGs + 150k wordmarks + generate_primitive_corpus families at random subpixel phase (the anchor-subpath phase-preservation trick from generate_rotated_glyph_pilot.py), sizes 8–512px; labels computed analytically with svgpathtools: exact intersection of each boundary crack with the source path. Augment: JPEG q60–95, Gaussian blur σ≤0.6, palette quantization through our own compact_palette, additive noise. Loss: Huber on δ where a crossing exists, BCE on w against 'is my δ within 0.1px of truth' (self-calibrating confidence). MiniNet 4x SR is retired from the boundary path (kept only as optional palette aid for ≤64px inputs); SEF operates on NATIVE raster always — consistent with the bitmap-native memory finding.

STAGE 2 — UNIVERSAL CRACK GRAPH. region_graph.py becomes the ONLY path (delete the ≥16-crack/8% gate). Every interface between two regions is fit ONCE; interfaces with <4 cracks are fit as a single line through SEF-adjusted midpoints; junction pinning as today. Seams become constructively impossible everywhere, not just on Mastercard-sized contacts. Background is a real bottom-layer region with re-estimated color, not a hardcoded white rect.

STAGE 3 — BOUNDARY TRANSFORMER (BT). Replaces corner_cnn as the perception front-end but keeps its proven input features. Per loop (or per interface chain), per boundary vertex i, build a token: [7-channel signed turning windows 1..21px (reuse corner_cnn.py feature code verbatim), SEF δ and w sampled at the two adjacent cracks, 16-d embedding of the local 9×9 raster patch from a shared tiny CNN, log loop-extent, local density]. Encoder: 5 transformer layers, d=128, 4 heads, circular relative positional encoding (loops are rings — rotary phase = 2πi/N), sequences tiled/strided for loops >2048 vertices. Heads per vertex: (1) corner probability p_i (calibrated with temperature scaling on held-out V4), (2) tangent θ_i as (sin2θ,cos2θ), (3) signed curvature κ_i (log-scaled, symlog), (4) 6-way primitive-class posterior q_i (line/circular-arc/elliptical-arc/clothoid/free-cubic/degenerate), (5) event type at corners (C0 structural / G1 tangent-jump / smooth), (6) glyph-membership g_i. Labels: corners from the V4 combined dataset (Hoshyari human layer immutable, exactly as the GT program mandates); tangents, curvatures, and primitive classes come FREE and EXACT from the analytic SVG GT — svg_corner_gt.py already walks the paths, we just also record dθ/ds and κ at each boundary sample and the source segment type. Glyph labels from the wordmark corpus (all loops = glyph) vs iconify non-text. Loss: BCE(corner, with 2px label smearing) + cosine(tangent) + Huber(κ) + CE(class) + CE(event) + BCE(glyph), corner head weighted 4×. ~12M params, one forward pass per image over all loops batched, ~20ms.

STAGE 4 — CORNER SELECTION WITH POSTERIORS (fixes gap #11: confidence finally reaches removal). Candidates = ALL local maxima of p_i above floor 0.10 (deliberately over-complete; recall problem becomes a precision problem, which removal solves). Recenter (existing) → collapse pairs with a GLYPH-AWARE window: base 16·spacing, but 4·spacing where mean g_i>0.6 on the loop (kills the adjacent-letter-corner eraser), and NEVER collapse a pair where both p>0.9 with opposite turning signs (serif feet). Then Algorithm-2 iterated removal with augmented energy: E = α·D + R + γ·Σ_{k∈kept} log((1−p_k)/p_k), α=32/extent as today, γ=1.5 (in units of r). Removing a p=0.97 corner now costs ~+5.2 in E; keeping a p=0.15 candidate costs ~+2.6 — the detector's belief and the geometric parsimony argue in ONE energy, lexicographic tie-break preserved.

STAGE 5 — DP FITTING WITH NARROWED INTERVALS AND PRIORS (fit_segment_midpoints, extended). Per crack i: interval center moves from m_i to m_i + δ_i·n_i and half-width shrinks to h_i = 0.5 − 0.35·w_i (floor 0.15px) — but ONLY where w_i > 0.7; low-confidence cracks keep the full ±0.5px, so SEF failure degrades to today's behavior exactly. Soft data term added to primitive cost: Σ w_i·(d_i/0.15px)² where d_i = normal distance from primitive to the SEF-adjusted point (this is what kills wobble: the fit is pulled to the true edge, not the quantization comb). Class prior term: −0.5·mean_i log q_i(class(P)) per primitive — a bias, never a veto. NEW PRIMITIVE: elliptical arc, r=3 (line=1, circular arc=2, elliptical arc=3, clothoid=4, cubic=5), fit by Fitzgibbon direct LSQ + Gauss-Newton refinement in the interval, seeded only on spans where q(ellipse) is argmax for ≥60% of vertices (keeps DP cheap). DP state stays (node, 12 tangent bins) + a 3-way curvature-sign bin for soft G2 preference (transition penalty 2.0 for sign flip within a smooth chain). Algorithm-1 repair loop unchanged. Corners at analytic support intersections unchanged (ellipse supports added to _intersect_supports).

STAGE 6 — G2 FAIRING (deterministic, bounded). Two mechanisms. (a) Clothoid Newton reprojection: replace the linear endpoint-drift smear with a 5-parameter Gauss-Newton solve (x0,y0,θ0,κ0,κ1) matching endpoints and end tangents exactly; ≤10 iterations; if residual >0.05px, keep the old curve — the result STAYS in the clothoid family. (b) Joint-local Euler blends: at every G1 joint inside a smooth chain where |Δκ| > 0.15/R_local, replace a window of length L = min(3px, 0.2·min(adjacent segment lengths)) with an Euler-spiral blend solved by Newton to match position/tangent/curvature on both sides. Accept per joint only if max normal deviation from the DP solution ≤0.4px and the loop still passes Hausdorff/IoU. Tagged exact arcs and lines are skipped (regularization identity preserved). This removes visible curvature steps on large silhouettes without any global re-optimization.

STAGE 7 — GESTALT PROPOSAL NET (RPN) + existing Sec-6. All current deterministic regularizers run first (they are precise where they apply). Then the RPN adds proposals the hand-written detectors structurally cannot make: mirror axes at ARBITRARY angle, rotation centers OFF centroid, repeated shapes with DIFFERENT primitive decompositions, near-grid layouts. Architecture: 4-layer graph-attention net over primitive tokens (type one-hot, params normalized by image diagonal, position, region id embedding, area); heads: (i) per-pair 'same shape under similarity transform' logit + predicted 4-dof transform, (ii) global mixture over K=8 mirror-axis hypotheses (angle, offset), (iii) rotation (center, N-fold logits 3..12). Training by TEACHER-STUDENT: an offline exact searcher (RANSAC over primitive-pair correspondences + Procrustes verification, minutes per icon, run once over iconify + the 365 annotated logos) manufactures ground-truth regularity annotations; the student learns to propose them in one 5ms pass. VERIFICATION IS THE EXISTING MACHINERY: every proposal is solved as a constrained least-squares snap and accepted only under the accuracy budget (length·sin(dev)≤1px, vertex move ≤2px, mirror residual ≤0.8px generalized to any axis) with snapshot+revert at >3px — the net can only ADD recall, never lose precision.

STAGE 8 — TEXT (see dedicated field) and TINY LOOPS (see dedicated field), both routed by BT's glyph head and loop extent.

STAGE 9 — BACKSTOP LADDER (staircase abolition). _finish_loop failure no longer ships the raw polyline. Refit ladder, first rung that passes gates wins: (1) re-run DP with vocabulary relaxed to {line, cubic}, G1 only, same intervals; (2) relax intervals to ±0.75px (Hausdorff gate still absolute); (3) Taubin-smoothed polyline (λ/μ standard, 10 iters) with BT corners pinned as hard vertices, decimated by RDP at 0.4px; (4) only then raw polyline, with a WARN counter in report.json that the harness treats as a failure. Rung 3 is already perceptually acceptable; rung 4 should become extinct (harness target: 0 occurrences on the 365-logo corpus).

STAGE 10 — EMIT. Everything as cubics rounded 0.01px (matching VAI forensics), z-order: occlusion templates bottom, background region, fills by area, glyph replacements TOPMOST (VAI secret #4). report.json gains per-model provenance: which cracks were SEF-narrowed, which corners came from which posterior, which regularities from RPN vs deterministic — full debuggability, per team requirement.

LATENCY BUDGET (RTX-class GPU): SEF 30ms + BT 20ms + RPN 5ms + TinyNet/GlyphNet a few ms + existing deterministic passes (already seconds) — comfortably interactive.
small_images: Tiny loops are today a binary cliff: whole-loop ellipse or literal pixel chain. ARGUS gives them three cooperating fixes. (1) SEF-Net is the star: an 8px circle's cracks carry ~0.1px-accurate true-boundary offsets, so even the ORDINARY DP path fits a genuinely round circle from 30 cracks — the quantization that made tiny fits square-ish is subtracted before fitting. SEF trains down to 8px rasters explicitly (the primitive corpus generator already emits them). (2) TinyNet: loops with extent ≤24px are additionally offered to a template head — a small CNN (2M params) on a 40×40 patch of [SEF soft-coverage, RGB, mask] classifying {circle, ellipse, square, rect, rounded-rect(+corner radius), diamond, triangle, capsule, cross, N-star, freeform} and regressing subpixel parameters (center, axes, angle, radius). Training: render templates at random subpixel phase/rotation via the phase-preserving pilot generator, plus 'freeform' negatives from iconify crops. VERIFICATION: render the proposed template's exact analytic coverage and gate on coverage MAE ≤0.08 against the source patch (alpha-weighted); fail → fall back to the SEF-boosted DP path, which is itself far better than today's floor. A tiny rounded square finally ships as a rounded square with one corner radius, not as an ellipse or a staircase. (3) The tiny-safe corner policy (already written, currently off) turns ON automatically when extent ≤24px — no global flag, the router decides per loop. MiniNet 4x is retired from the geometry path (no more deblur-then-trace round trip for small lossless inputs); it remains only as a palette assist for ≤64px images where median-cut starves for samples.
text: Text is where the 0.73 corner recall and the IoU-gate staircase disaster live, and it becomes a first-class routed path. (1) DETECTION: BT's per-vertex glyph head g_i (trained on 150k wordmarks as positives, iconify as negatives) is averaged per loop; loops with ḡ>0.6 are glyph-suspect. Suspect loops sharing a baseline band (existing baseline detector) are grouped into words. (2) SAFE FITTING BY DEFAULT: glyph-suspect loops automatically get the existing text-safe _finish_loop profile (the known fix that is currently OFF), the 4·spacing collapse window, and the serif-guard (never collapse opposite-sign p>0.9 pairs) — this alone recovers the known 5-8-primitive glyphs that today get replaced by 29-86 staircase lines, and adjacent letter corners stop being erased. Expected post-pipeline corner event-F1 on small text: 0.73 → ≥0.85, because (a) BT sees raster patches, not just turning signals, (b) the candidate floor is 0.10 with removal doing precision, (c) SEF sharpens the turning signal itself. (3) GLYPH REPLACEMENT: font_match.py finally enters the pipeline, upgraded with a character-class posterior from a small glyph classifier (64×64 patch CNN trained on the wordmark corpus renders — we know the font and string for every training sample) that narrows the font/char search space so retrieval runs interactively. Per-glyph acceptance gate (all must pass): fill-IoU ≥0.93 against the raster mask, chamfer ≤0.6px at operating scale, hole-count topology match, and per-WORD consistency (single font, monotone advance widths, shared baseline within 0.5px). Accepted words are re-emitted from the actual font outlines under the found affine+tracking, placed TOPMOST in z-order (the VAI trick), then run through baseline/cap-height regularization. Rejected words keep the text-safe geometric fit — which is now good, so the gate can stay conservative. (4) COLOR: glyph fills get the Stage-0 re-estimated color (letters are exactly where 1px-thin regions made anchor colors wrong).
symmetry_idealization: Idealization = the accuracy-budgeted snap machinery (which is correct and stays) fed by a recall-complete proposal stream. Today's Sec-6 finds only what its hand-written detectors enumerate: vertical/horizontal mirrors, centroid rotations, identical-decomposition repeats. The RPN closes the enumeration gap: arbitrary-angle mirror axes (a shield logo tilted 3° gets its true axis, then the axis itself is offered to the axis-snap regularizer — if it's within 8° of vertical it snaps, otherwise it is honored as-is), off-centroid rotation centers (regressed directly, verified by Procrustes residual), and shape repeats matched by learned similarity over normalized outline descriptors rather than identical primitive degree sequences (two arrows fit as arc+3 lines vs clothoid+2 lines still unify: the verifier re-fits BOTH from the canonical exemplar and accepts only if each stays within its own interval tube and Hausdorff gate). Bounding is unchanged and non-negotiable: every snap passes length·sin(dev)≤1px, vertex movement ≤2px, mirror residual ≤0.8px (now measured against any proposed axis), snapshot+revert at >3px deviation, and the loop-level Hausdorff/IoU gates re-run after regularization. The teacher-student trick guarantees honesty: the teacher is an EXACT offline searcher, so training labels contain no perceptual wishfulness — the student only learns to find, fast, what exhaustive geometry would have found slowly. Idealization amplitude therefore never exceeds today's certified budget; only its COVERAGE grows to match human expectation (and VAI's global template optimization). Additionally, corner posteriors make symmetry more STABLE: symmetric shapes get symmetric corner sets (BT is trained with dihedral augmentation from corner_classifier.py's ×8 scheme), so the mirror residual test stops failing on asymmetric corner detections of symmetric shapes — a silent killer of today's mirror snaps.
artifact_elimination: SEAMS: structurally eliminated, not mitigated — the crack graph becomes the universal path (gate removed), every interface fit exactly once and shared by both regions; sub-4-crack interfaces are single SEF-centered lines; junctions pinned to one point; background is a real bottom region, so nothing white can show through. A hairline scanner (render 4x, flag background-colored 1px inter-region paths) enters benchmark_stages with a floor of ZERO on the 365-logo corpus. STAIRCASES: the fallback ladder (relaxed-vocabulary refit → widened interval → Taubin+pinned-corners polyline) means the raw pixel chain is unreachable in practice; the harness counts rung-4 events as failures; separately, SEF-narrowed intervals make the primary DP succeed far more often, and text-safe gating stops the IoU gate from demoting valid glyph fits. WOBBLE: root cause is fitting to quantized crack midpoints — the SEF soft term pulls every primitive to the true subpixel edge (Huber-trained to 0.08px), and the wobble metric (high-frequency energy of the tangent-angle signal of the fitted outline) is added to the harness so aesthetic regressions can no longer pass silently. CURVATURE STEPS: G2 arrives twice — curvature-sign bins in the DP state discourage κ sign flips inside smooth chains, and the deterministic fairing pass (clothoid Gauss-Newton reprojection that STAYS in-family, plus Euler-spiral joint blends matching κ on both sides, each bounded to 0.4px and re-gated) removes the remaining |Δκ| jumps; harness gains a max-|Δκ|-at-joints metric on smooth silhouettes with a ≥5x reduction gate. WRONG CORNERS (both kinds): missed corners fixed by the over-complete 0.10-floor candidate set + BT raster-aware perception + glyph-aware collapse windows; spurious corners fixed by posterior-augmented Algorithm-2 removal where a low-confidence corner now literally costs energy to keep. Corners land at analytic support intersections as today, so position accuracy is inherited, and ellipse supports mean elliptical shoulders stop being paved with cubic patchwork (gap #6 closed).

new_components.name: SEF-Net (Subpixel Edge Field)
new_components.what: ~1.5M-param UNet: raster + label map -> per-crack signed offset (tanh-bounded ±0.5px) + self-calibrated confidence; data generator with analytic crack-crossing labels from svgpathtools over iconify/wordmarks/primitive corpus at random subpixel phase with JPEG/blur/palette augmentation; DP integration (interval re-centering w>0.7, soft pull term)

new_components.name: Boundary Transformer (BT)
new_components.what: 5-layer d=128 circular transformer over per-vertex tokens (turning channels + SEF samples + 9x9 patch embedding); heads: calibrated corner p, tangent, curvature, 6-way primitive class, event type, glyph membership; label extension of svg_corner_gt.py; posterior-augmented removal energy and DP class priors; temperature calibration on V4 held-out

new_components.name: Universal crack graph + backstop ladder + color/alpha fixes
new_components.what: Remove the >=16-crack gate, short-interface line fitting, background-as-region; 4-rung fallback ladder replacing raw staircase; final color re-estimation by eroded-interior trimmed mean; alpha-aware labeling; elliptical-arc primitive (Fitzgibbon+GN) with support intersection

new_components.name: G2 fairing pass
new_components.what: Clothoid 5-param Gauss-Newton endpoint reprojection (stays in family, <=0.05px residual or revert) + Euler-spiral joint blends where |dk| > 0.15/R over min(3px, 0.2*seg) windows, each gated at 0.4px deviation + full loop re-verification

new_components.name: TinyNet template head
new_components.what: 2M-param CNN on 40x40 [SEF coverage, RGB, mask] patches: 11-way template class + subpixel parameter regression; phase-accurate synthetic training; analytic-coverage MAE <=0.08 acceptance gate; automatic tiny-safe routing for extent <=24px

new_components.name: Gestalt Proposal Net (RPN)
new_components.what: Offline exact teacher (RANSAC primitive-correspondence + Procrustes over iconify + 365 logos) manufacturing regularity GT; 4-layer graph-attention student proposing arbitrary-angle mirrors, off-center rotations, cross-decomposition repeats; all proposals solved as constrained LSQ under existing budgets with snapshot+revert

new_components.name: Glyph head + font_match integration
new_components.what: 64x64 char-class CNN (wordmark corpus, known font/string) narrowing font_match search; word grouping by baseline; per-glyph gates (IoU>=0.93, chamfer<=0.6px, topology, per-word font/baseline consistency); accepted words emitted from font outlines, topmost z-order; rejects keep text-safe geometric fit

new_components.name: Perceptual harness + VAI A/B
new_components.what: Seam scanner, wobble (tangent-angle HF energy), joint |dk| metric, circle roundness, rung-4 fallback counter — all as benchmark_stages floors; blinded human A/B review UI (reuse dataset review UI) + MAE/RMSE@4x against vectorizer.ai on 50 logos

risks: SEF domain gap on real-world JPEG/photographed logos: offsets could be confidently wrong on textures the augmentation never covered. Mitigated three ways: tanh ±0.5px architectural clamp, confidence gate (w<=0.7 -> exact current behavior), and the Hausdorff backstop measured against RAW cracks — worst case is today's output, never worse.

BT glyph head overfitting to the wordmark corpus's font distribution; decorative/script logotypes may be missed (falls back to normal fitting — safe) or false-positived (text-safe profile on a non-glyph loop is slightly conservative but not harmful). Monitor via the 365-logo human review.

Posterior-augmented removal energy (γ=1.5) changes the corner equilibrium globally; needs a full sweep on compare_corner_pipeline.py before promotion — a miscalibrated temperature could suppress geometric corners the old α·D+R kept. Calibration is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.

RPN teacher compute: exact regularity search over iconify is days of CPU; must be run once, cached, and versioned. Student precision is protected by verification, but student RECALL below teacher recall would understate the payoff — track separately.

Universal crack graph on complex segmentations (hundreds of regions) may hit junction-resolution edge cases the >=16-crack gate previously hid; needs the saddle-resolution code exercised on the full 365-logo corpus before the gate is deleted.
Latency creep: five models plus fairing must stay inside the interactive budget; enforce a per-stage ms budget in the harness (fail the gate if p95 image time >4s at 512px).

Elliptical arcs in DP can absorb spans that are perceptually circular (ellipse with 1.02 axis ratio) and break co-circular regularization; guard: eccentricity floor (b/a<0.97) before the ellipse class is admitted, else it collapses to the circle candidate.

The 0.01px cubic-only emission changes downstream SVG diffs and certified-logo baselines; re-certify Mastercard/Mobil/NBC/Lacoste IoUs immediately after the emitter change, before any ML lands, so regressions are attributable.
staged_plan: STAGE A (week 1, no ML): universal crack graph, backstop ladder, alpha fix, color re-estimation, elliptical arc, clothoid Gauss-Newton, text-safe/tiny-safe auto-routing by existing heuristics, cubic-only 0.01px emitter. GATE: all benchmark_stages floors hold; certified logos re-certified (IoU within 0.002 of 0.9901/0.9849/0.9855/0.9380 or better); seam scanner = 0 hairlines on 365 logos; rung-4 fallback count reported (baseline recorded).

STAGE B (weeks 2-3): SEF-Net data generator + training + DP integration behind a flag. GATE: median |δ error| <=0.08px and 90th percentile <=0.2px on held-out synthetic (unseen fonts + primitive families); with flag ON: wobble metric down >=40% on the smooth-silhouette suite, Hausdorff floors unchanged, tiny-circle roundness (radial std/R) <=0.02 at 12px; no certified-logo regression.

STAGE C (weeks 3-5): BT training + calibration + posterior-flow integration (candidate floor 0.10, augmented removal, glyph-aware collapse). GATE: compare_corner_pipeline.py event-F1 >=0.85 overall and >=0.82 on the small-text slice (from 0.73); tangent error <=3 deg median on analytic GT; benchmark_stages corner-F1 floor raised from 0.68 to 0.80; zero floor regressions.

STAGE D (week 5): G2 fairing ON. GATE: max |Δκ| at joints down >=5x on the smooth-silhouette suite; Hausdorff and IoU floors unchanged; visual review of 20 large-silhouette logos shows no new bulges (human check via review UI).

STAGE E (week 6): TinyNet + glyph/font_match integration. GATE: tiny-icon suite (new: 200 iconify icons rendered at 16-32px) template accuracy >=90% with coverage-MAE gate active; wordmark suite: >=60% of words replaced by font outlines at zero false replacements (gate conservativeness verified by human review of all replacements on 365 logos); text slice IoU floor raised.

STAGE F (weeks 7-8): RPN teacher run + student training + proposal integration. GATE: on teacher-annotated held-out icons, pipeline symmetry recall (axes/rotations actually snapped) >=2x current Sec-6 recall at zero precision loss (verifier guarantees); snapshot+revert count monitored (reverts <=5% of proposals or thresholds revisited).

STAGE G (week 8, continuous after): VAI A/B harness — 50-logo blinded human ranking + MAE/RMSE@4x. GATE (the prize): win-or-tie >=70%, outright win >=45% against vectorizer.ai on perceptual ranking; IKEA forensics case MAE < 4.66 (beat VAI's own number on their showcase).
why_beats_vai: VAI's advantages, per our own forensics, are exactly four: hidden-layer completion (we already do it), global template/level optimization (RPN + universal budgeted regularization matches it), uniform ultra-smooth cubic emission (Stage-A emitter + G2 fairing matches it), and letters redrawn on top (glyph replacement matches it) — while VAI has NO answer to our two structural trumps. First, certified fidelity: every ARGUS primitive is proven within a pixel-anchored tube against the raw raster; VAI's global optimizer occasionally idealizes wrongly and has no revert — on the 365-logo corpus those are exactly the cases we win outright. Second, the perception ceiling: our corner/edge/symmetry perception is trained on analytic ground truth with a human-verified layer and flows as calibrated probability into a discrete optimizer, rather than being baked into a monolithic pipeline — when it's wrong, the deterministic spine catches it; when it's right, the output is not merely smooth but CORRECTLY idealized (true subpixel edges via SEF, true corner sets on 8px text, diagonal mirrors VAI's regularizer also finds but cannot certify). The gap analysis is falsifiable at every stage: each artifact class VAI beats us on today (seams, staircases, curvature steps, text butchery, missed symmetry) is closed by a specific component with a measurable gate, and the remaining artifact classes are ones where we are already ahead (Hausdorff-certified accuracy, occlusion semantics, gradient/stroke structure). Beating VAI perceptually is then not a hope — it is the conjunction of seven gates, each independently verifiable on this codebase's existing harness.
